items.html: *And you must know that when he comes out of his mother's womb and is born, he is still as at the beginning, at the time of the pregnancy, for he must still grow his limbs and correct them; and this growth and correction is from the day he is born until the completion of nine years. And this measure is that he grows and corrects all the nine Sefirot within him, as we counted them in the third phase of the time of the fetus, and see there. And they are the six ends within him and the three Mochin — these are the nine Sefirot within him.
